body:
After being kicked out of the server, automatically launch Senren * Banka or other files. Ciallo～(∠・ω< )⌒★

You can enter multiple Steam APP IDs or file paths. When multiple are entered, one will be randomly selected to launch. Starting in full-screen mode may cause issues that prevent the program from launching normally, so it is recommended not to enable it. Our configuration file is named yzljc_launchapp_config.json.

被服务器踢出后自动打开千恋*万花或其他文件 Ciallo～(∠・ω< )⌒★

你可以输入多个Steam APP ID或者文件路径，当输入多个时会随机抽取一个启动
全屏模式启动可能会有问题导致程序没有正常启动，建议不要开
我们的配置文件名字为yzljc_launchapp_config.json
